q: How do I rent a vehicle for ride sharing?
a: Pick a car from our fleet, send your licence details and confirm the booking. Our team verifies your documents and hands over the keys.

q: Can I rent for a short period or long term?
a: Both work. You can book from a single day up to several months, and longer plans get a lower daily rate.

q: Is insurance included with the rental?
a: Insurance is an add on. Switch the insurance toggle on while booking and the cost is added to your total.

q: What is the minimum age to rent a car?
a: Drivers must be at least 21 years old and must hold a valid licence for at least one year.

q: Can I extend my rental period if needed?
a: Yes. Contact support before your return date and we will extend the booking if the car is free.
